bullets.text: Residents in Tiruvallur took to the roads at midnight to protest against continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor the local electricity supply situation.
A sudden road subsidence near Nehru Nagar caused traffic disruptions in Velachery, and the office should coordinate with transport authorities to clear the route.
An orange alert for heavy rain has been issued for Thiruvallur and Chennai due to Cyclone Murasu, and the district team must prepare disaster response measures.
Minister Pussy Anand inaugurated a marathon in Besant Nagar to raise drug abuse awareness among youth, and the Velachery team should note local anti-drug outreach efforts.
Parents and students in Mampakkam Chathiram near Tirutani are worried about venomous creatures in a bushy school campus, and the office should urge authorities to clear the overgrowth.
Southern Railway announced a new suburban electric train timetable effective November 1, including a new service from Thiruvallur to Moore Market Complex, which the office should note.
Damaged and missing concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar road over bridge in Thiruvallur pose safety risks, and the office should direct the State Highways department to undertake repairs.
The Tamil Nadu government launched a master plan to resolve public grievances in urban civic bodies from a single location, and our portfolio team should oversee its implementation.
Larsen & Toubro has begun constructing the Vyoma.AI 52MW data center in Chennai to boost AI infrastructure, and the portfolio team should support regional tech investments.
The TVK IT wing deleted an AI-generated deepfake video mimicking DMK leader M.K. Stalin after it sparked controversy, and our office should monitor the political fallout.
